name: Exire: The Fire Will Find You
source:
A group of friends breaks into an abandoned house, only to learn the rumored hauntings are real. Now, they must escape before it's too late! But whose voice is begging you to stay? Why is it... familiar?

Explore the house and work with your friends to find a way out, and learn the truth about Winchester Manor's past along the way. Will you find a way to escape, or will the flames consume you first?

Remember, passion and fear go hand in hand when your life is on the line.

Exire: The Fire Will Find You is a psychological horror visual novel submitted for Spooktober VN Game Jam 2026.

The story is based on the song Winchester 111 by I The Mighty and the Winchester Mystery House located in California. 

[From [url=https://rakumaroo.itch.io/exire-the-fire-will-find-you]itch.io[/url]]
